title: Anchoring the Appeal Decision Window on the Denial Date or the End of Supply — Prescription Insurance on File
content:
**A1.** Under **Prescription Insurance on File**, the start of the appeal decision window of an appeal against a prior authorization denial is anchored by when the appeal is filed, measured from the date of the most recent denial on the coverage:

(a) An appeal filed no more than **10** calendar days after the date of that most recent denial is anchored on the denial date, so the calendar days from the denial date to the filing date are taken off the window.

(b) An appeal filed later than 10 calendar days after that denial while supply is left at filing is anchored on the day that supply runs out, so the days of supply left at filing are added to the window.

(c) Any other appeal is anchored on the filing date, and nothing is taken off or added.

**A2. Supply left at filing.** The appealed drug is the prescription the most recent denial on the coverage concerns. Supply left at filing is the days supply billed on the most recent claim paid for the appealed drug under a prior authorization approval, less the calendar days from that claim's date of service to the filing date, and never less than 0; supply is left when that figure is 1 day or more.

## Worked dates (hypothetical: most recent denial dated 1 March)

| Filing date | Days after the denial | Supply left at filing | Anchor | Effect on the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 0 | any | Denial date | 0 days taken off |
| 4 March | 3 | any | Denial date | 3 days taken off |
| 11 March | 10 | any | Denial date | 10 days taken off |
| 12 March | 11 | 6 days | End of supply | 6 days added |
| 12 March | 11 | 0 days | Filing date | Nothing taken off or added |
| 20 March | 19 | 2 days | End of supply | 2 days added |

## Supply figure (hypothetical)

The most recent approved claim for the appealed drug billed 30 days on 20 February. For an appeal filed on 12 March, 20 calendar days have passed, so 10 days of supply are left at filing; filed 11 days after a 1 March denial, the appeal is anchored on the end of supply and 10 days are added.
